verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an agent-payments product, so per-call HTTP 402 API monetization is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only covers retail checkout flows: ACP/UCP checkout sessions, tokenized shopper credentials passed to merchants, and product feeds. Nothing documents HTTP 402 responses, x402-style machine payments, or per-call API metering without checkout. Those adjacent checkout and tokenization features do not transfer to this story.
